Accordion Content

Fall Semester 2025

  • September

    • Sep 3 (Wed) Fall classes begin

  • October

    • Oct 13 (Mon) Columbus Day/Indigenous Peoples Day – No classes
    • Oct 22 (Wed) First quarter ends
    • Oct 23 (Thu) Second quarter begins

  • November

    • Nov 11 (Tue) Veterans’ Day (observed) – No classes
    • Nov 12 (Wed) Tuesday Class schedule (Wed classes will not meet on 11/12)
    • Nov 26 (Wed) Thanksgiving Recess Begins at the
      close of Day classes on Wednesday (Evening classes will not meet on 11/26)
    • Nov 27 (Thu) Thanksgiving recess

  • December

    • Dec 1 (Mon) Classes Resume
    • Dec 9 (Tue) Tuesday evening class final exam
    • Dec 10 (Wed) Last Day of Instruction - Day Classes.
    • Dec 11 (Thu) Reading Day (day classes only)
    • Dec 11 (Thu) Thursday evening class final exam
    • Dec 12 (Fri) Day class final examinations begin
    • Dec 15 (Mon) Monday evening class final exam
    • Dec 17 (Wed) Wednesday evening class final exam
    • Dec 18 (Thu) Day class final examinations end
    • Dec 19 (Fri) Snow Day final examinations (This is an extra day in the event of a snow day during finals week)

NOTE:  Final examinations must be administered as scheduled, unless the appropriate College Dean has granted an exemption. Final grades are due by Tuesday, December 23rd.

Spring Semester 2026

  • January

    • Jan 21 (Wed) First Day of Classes

  • February

    • Feb 16 (Mon) Presidents’ Day – No classes
    • Feb 18 (Wed) Monday schedule of classes (Wednesday classes will not meet on 2/18)

  • March

    • Mar 9 (Mon) Spring break begins
    • Mar 13 (Fri) Spring break ends
    • Mar 17 (Tue) Third quarter ends
    • Mar 18 (Wed) Fourth quarter begins

  • April

    • Apr 20 (Mon) Patriots’ Day – No classes
    • Apr 30 (Thu) Thursday evening class final exam

  • May

    • May 4 (Mon) Last Day of Instruction - day classes
    • May 5 (Tue) Reading Day (day classes only)
    • May 5 (Tue) Tuesday evening class final exam
    • May 6 (Wed) Day class final examinations begin
    • May 6 (Wed) Wednesday evening class final exam
    • May 11 (Mon) Monday evening class final exam
    • May 12 (Tue) Day class final examinations end
    • May 14 (Thu) Graduate Commencement
    • May 15 (Fri) Undergraduate Commencement

Note:  Final examinations must be administered as scheduled, unless the appropriate College Dean has granted an exemption. Final grades are due by Friday, May 15th.

Summer Sessions 2026

  • May

    • May 26 (Tue) Summer Session I classes begin

  • June

    • Jun 19 (Fri) Juneteenth - no classes
    • Jun 29 (Mon) Summer Session I classes end

  • July

    • Jul 13 (Mon) Summer Session II classes begin

  • August

    • Aug 14 (Fri) Summer Session II classes end

NOTE:  Summer final examinations will be given on the last scheduled meeting of the class.  Final examinations must be administered as scheduled, unless the appropriate College Dean has granted an exemption.  Final grades for Summer I are due by Thursday July 2.  Final grades for Summer II are due by Wednesday, August 19.
